parameters.name: forceSuccess
parameters.description:
是否强制更新。
  - true：强制更新
  - false：不强制更新

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls consumer-group-update-check-point --project ali-test-project --logstore ali-test-logstore --consumer-group consumer_group_test --consumer consumer_1 --force-success true --shard 0 --checkpoint MTUyNDE1NTM3OTM3MzkwODQ5Ng== --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls POST /logstores/ali-test-logstore/consumergroups/consumer_group_test?type=checkpoint --project ali-test-project --region cn-hangzhou --forceSuccess true --consumer consumer_1 --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"checkpoint":"MTUyNDE1NTM3OTM3MzkwODQ5Ng==","shard":0}
